Iteration507: Native serial eSIM ownership is sticky and independent of SMS readiness. Deferred plain Close captures the original session, and successful permit release wakes pending SMS receive work. Go still owns serial lifecycle.

Iteration508: Full native ownership is sticky, independent of SMS readiness, and enforced again when legacy wire work reaches the actor.
